title: data API: a host-configurable default and maximum page size for list, report and analytics reads, and a per-query scanned-row budget, refused with a structured code and logged (framework seam for cloud)
body:
repo:cloud#2 · os-zhuang · session_0123kRqqdpAJWYMgsgdAJX4G

Filing gate: executing the maintainer's instruction of 2026-11-03 04:26Z (decision thread on cloud plans), verbatim: 「同意：在代码里补两个保护再谈放宽：查询扫描行预算和强制分页；每周看板加「每个 Team 组织的数据库大小与行读量」。第 3 个月闸门前有这两组数，再决定存储包价格和数据边界的数字。」 Also 04:25Z: 「暂时不考虑存储包，等有了实际用户再说」. Evaluation: https://claude.ai/artifact/Vq1N6ZfXMmfy8sXcupU26t, the 数据量增长 section.

## Why this is a framework card

Dedupe on objectstack `main`: no general page-size cap exists in the data API or in the SQL / libSQL driver. `driver-odata` has `pageSize` only for its own upstream, and MCP has `maxQueryLimit` only for its own tool. The hosted data plane runs the framework's data API, so the gate belongs here. Cloud only sets the numbers.

## Ask

- **Forced pagination:** list, report and analytics (问数) reads get a default page size and a maximum page size. A request over the maximum is clamped or refused, as one documented rule.
- **Scanned-row budget:** a per-query limit on rows the driver may scan or return. Over the budget, the query is refused with a structured code (for example `QUERY_ROW_BUDGET_EXCEEDED`), the limit is named, and a log or metric line is written with object and count, never row content.
- **Host configuration:** both numbers come from host configuration with safe defaults, so cloud can set them per deployment. One value for every plan is enough for now.
- **Tests:** the clamp, the refusal shape, and that defaults leave today's self-hosted behaviour working.

## Reader

objectstack triage (data API / driver lane). Cloud picks this up in its own card once a pin carries it.
